note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/e0030901/cash-bids?units=us — the site id e0030901 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://fscooperatives.com/aglandfs/agriculture/cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (4199) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. One run said floor-cent (8 testable rows, margin 8) and there is no second run to agree with it. A mode is a property of how they compute their board, so it needs the same answer on a different day's prices. Left off, the identity guard stays exact and a board that does not reconcile refuses loudly instead of publishing under a mode nobody established. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 8 row(s) for this location. STATE AND ADDRESS READ, NOT INFERRED. Premier, Allied, Country Partners, Country Visions and Ag-Land FS each publish their own locations list; the state and street below were read off it on 2026-08-25 and not inferred from the operator's headquarters. CASH ROUNDING MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. The first live run refused all five with 'cash - basis = futures' residuals of -0.25c to -0.75c. Corn futures trade in QUARTER cents and this board displays cash to the whole cent, so the identity cannot reconstruct exactly from the two displayed figures. Tested against all 80 refused rows from that run: floor-to-the-cent explains 80 of 80, round explains 52, ceiling explains 0. Not a tolerance and not a fudge -- the rule their own board uses, which then makes the check exact again. COORDINATE filled 40.7726,-89.9289 from geocodes/places.json on 2026-08-29, keyed on this source's own id and resolved from "Elmwood" via zip-centroid. It is the CENTROID OF THE TOWN's ZIPs, which can be miles from the yard. EVIDENCE, NOT A FACT: check it against the operator's own published address before anything depends on the distance.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
